claims.claim: This is a scrap compact audio system that is currently not functioning; sold as is for parts or recycling.
claims.evidence: Witness photos show a silver/grey built-in-looking oven/stove unit labeled “MARS TAR,” not an audio system, and no power-on/heating test is shown.

claims.claim: All keys and buttons working, adapter included.
claims.evidence: No photo/video shows an audio system being powered or keys/buttons tested; witness report shows an oven/stove control panel only.

claims.claim: Bought from the UK, no dead key, no crackle.
claims.evidence: No receipt, label, or test evidence shown in the witness report.

risks.risk: Item identity mismatch: seller describes an audio system, but witness photos show a “MARS TAR” oven/stove unit; buyer may receive the wrong category of appliance.
risks.proof: A clear photo/video of the exact item being sold (front label/model plate) plus a shot showing whether it is an audio system or an oven/stove.
risks.if_unproven: Price at worst case for a non-matching/uncertain item: treat as scrap/for parts with no guarantee of function.

risks.risk: Functionality unknown: no heating/ignition/power-on test shown; could be dead or have faulty elements/controls.
risks.proof: Short power-on video showing the oven/stove heating/ignition and indicator behavior (and, if electric, temperature rise).
risks.if_unproven: Price as not working (parts/recycling), since operation is not demonstrated.

risks.risk: Missing accessories/parts: trays/racks/knobs/manuals and any required components are not shown.
risks.proof: Inventory photos of all included parts (trays/racks/knobs/adapters/cables/manuals) laid out clearly.
risks.if_unproven: Price as incomplete: assume missing accessories and reduce value accordingly.

risks.risk: Electrical/gas compatibility and safety: power type (gas vs electric) and required voltage/amperage not shown; could be incompatible or unsafe.
risks.proof: Photo of the rating plate/spec label showing voltage/amperage or gas type/regulator requirements.
risks.if_unproven: Price at worst case for compatibility risk: treat as requiring buyer to handle installation/testing.

risks.risk: Physical condition issues: witness notes dust/marks and wear around door/front panel; door seal and glass integrity not confirmed.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of door glass, hinges, and gasket/seal; plus a shot showing the door closes flush.
risks.if_unproven: Price as potentially needing cleaning/repair and assume possible seal/glass issues.

proof_requests: Send clear photos of the rating/model plate (including voltage/amperage or gas specs) and the exact model number/serial number.
Send a short power-on/heating (or ignition) video showing it actually works and how the indicators behave.
Confirm what the item is: provide a photo that clearly shows whether it is an audio system or the “MARS TAR” oven/stove unit.
Show all included accessories (trays/racks/knobs/adapters/cables/manuals) laid out and counted.
Provide close-ups of the oven door glass and the door gasket/seal.
response.reason: The witness report identifies an oven/stove labeled “MARS TAR,” while the seller claims an audio system; functionality and key details (model, power type, accessories) are not shown. Without proof of the correct item and whether it works, a reliable worst-case price cannot be set.
